title.narrative: Support for the preparation of the UIA International Forum on Affordable Housing

description.narrative:
In 2018 The city of Madrid was selected by the Union Internationale des Architectes (UIA) for hosting the 1st UIA INTERNATIONAL FORUM ON “AFFORDABLE HOUSING”, the second of international thematic events that are being organized by UIA every 3 years. The event will take place in May 2022 and will be directly organized by the Spanish Chapter of UIA (Spanish Council of Architects - CSCAE).
This forum is called to be an important global event for the debate on the issue of housing, particularly in relation to its affordability, from a human rights perspective. It will gather a significant number of global actors predominantly from the architecture and will have wide media coverage. The CSCAE has been seeking the support of a group of relevant public and private actors from Spain, including the National Government, the Regional Government and the Madrid City Council, which implies a high commitment and a guarantee of success. Although the planned format is that of a 5-day face-to-face summit, including plenary activities, side-events and other parallel activities, the idea is that the summit constitutes the culmination of a longer process, which includes regional preparatory meetings and eventually, meetings around thematic areas.
The CSCAE has requested UN-Habitat to provide substantive support for the organization of the Forum and advise on relation to the thematic content for the debates of the preliminary and main events. Being a global event organized by the one of the main professional associations related to housing sectors, the forum seems to be a relevant opportunity for progressing on the implementation of the UN-Habitat Global Housing Strategy (GHS) as well as the Compact for housing solutions, that requires full involvement of all stakeholders at global, national, city and locality levels for its ownership and success.
In this sense, the main objective of this project, aligned with the expected outcomes of the UN-Habitat Global Housing Strategy and the Compact for Housing Solutions (in approval process) is to the objective of the project is to increase awareness and facilitate knowledge and experience exchange on adequate housing affordability related issues.
The project activities and outputs, mainly focused on the preparation of the Forum, are supposed to be part of the activities and outputs of the Compact for Housing Solutions (CHS) project. As the official approval and launching of the CHS has been postponed, and the UIA Forum is expected to be happen in May 2022, the project is being proposed separately: nevertheless, outcomes of the Forum, implemented together with the Housing, Land and Shelter Section, will contribute to the CHS project implementation.
The role of UN-Habitat on the preparation of the Forum would include: to provide support for the conceptualization of the event, to provide substantive support for the preparation and organization of regional preparatory meetings, to provide support on the identification of speakers and potential side-event organizers and to support in the mobilization towards the event.
The project has a single expected accomplishment:
EA.1. Increased knowledge exchange, advocacy generated and strengthened alliances with global stakeholders related to affordable housing on the framework of the UN-Habitat Compact for Housing Solutions and the New Urban Agenda.
Following outcomes are expected to be achieved:
• Outcome 1: Affordable Housing knowledge is promoted and exchanged among relevant stakeholders. • Outcome 2: UN-Habitat´s People-Centred Approach to Housing is being promoted globally among relevant stakeholders
The work plan will be based on the following lines of work with activities and follow-up of agreements in each of them:
1. Provide support in the substantive documents of the event: particularly in relation to the establishment of the concept paper including proposals for the identification of barriers, the identification of the main points for the debates. 2. Provide support for the preparation of regional meetings: the preparatory process for the Forum includes several regional preparatory meetings, in order to provide inputs in relation to the main event discussion topics, as well as to identify challenges - general at global or regional level, but also particular - in relation to the housing sector, the presentation of solutions and alternatives and the identification of good practices. Each regional preparatory meeting will be organized by the corresponding UIA regional chapter. 3. Provide support in the identification of official sources of information for the preparation of a registry of existing indicator frameworks associated with housing affordability at a global level, which are public and accessible, of supranational nature (list of existing online databases) and relevant in relation to the forum areas (10-15 databases). 4.
